sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, as reported from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and cites its sources beside it. Where no source confirms a method yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done, so there is no separate task to plan for it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and activities, then collectibles and money — and this is the reward at the end of it. Press-Start's launch-day list and every tracker agree it is the only platinum in the set, worth 0 Gamerscore on Xbox, where the same 54 achievements add up to 1,000G.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the activities, collectibles, robberies and money trophies.
Earn A Long Road (100% completion) last or near-last; the platinum follows automatically.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, and the first story trophy most players earn. Play through Gone Fishing as the story directs you; there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss, since it is the mission the game starts with. KeenGamer's roadmap lists it as the natural first step of the story run, and the official description names the mission outright.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: the game has no mission replay.
steps: Play all Chapter 1 missions in order.
Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Save manually at the chapter start in case you need to come back.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — the gold every launch-week guide calls the hardest trophy in the set. KeenGamer and EGamers both rank it hardest, and PowerPyx puts the platinum at roughly 200 hours largely because of it. The checklist is the game's own: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed it, so work it last, after the story, and tick it off against the in-game list rather than guessing. EGamers notes PowerPyx puts the true-completion bar leniently, near 60% of everything countable, but the in-game checklist is still the authority.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands first.
Clear activities, collectibles, exploration and robberies — they feed the checklist.
Open the in-game 100% checklist and finish whatever it still lists.
The gold pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the tally, which the game tracks for you. It is a grind, not a skill test: fold stunts into everything else you do (driving between missions, races, exploration) instead of grinding all 250 in one sitting. KeenGamer's roadmap lists it among the long activity grinds on the road to the platinum.
steps: Drive aggressively everywhere: jumps, drifts and near-misses build the count.
Check the stunt tally in the game as you go.
Keep stunting during races and exploration until 250 is reached.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — one taste of each is enough, no wins or medals needed. The starter list puts the count at 9 types, covering the activities named across the other trophies: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and stunts. Work it early in Chapter 2, when both protagonists are playable and the map opens up, and tick each type off as you try it.
steps: From Chapter 2, try one race, one fishing spot and one arcade game.
Try bowling, the shooting range and a drone race.
Try meditation, hunting and a stunt — one of each type earns it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — the starter list puts the count at 42 challenges, so this is a long accuracy grind. Practice each range's weapon and target pattern, and replay a challenge as many times as you need: medals are per-challenge, so you can gold them one at a time instead of in one run. KeenGamer lists it among the skill trophies that reward patience over story progress.
steps: Visit a shooting range and try each challenge to learn its targets.
Replay challenges until each one is gold — they are scored individually.
Work through all 42 challenges; the silver pops on the last gold.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it in open country with a fast car ready: earn the stars away from tight streets, then break line of sight, switch vehicles if you can, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. The partner must be with you when the wanted level drops, so do not split up mid-escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: you must keep the heat on the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving between them so the wanted level never fully clears. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps; do not stop to fight the police between robberies.
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast car nearby.
Rob the first shop with your partner, then move straight to the next.
Keep your wanted level alive through all three robberies.
